name: Office Noun · Skate Team
description: Office Skate Team, series one. Twenty-five decks, each a whole Noun from the official CC0 Nouns traits on a deck drawn by the Office Noun X desk. Decks 01 to 13 are free. Some decks are nods to Nouns friends; Office Noun is not affiliated with them. Keepsakes. No coin, no promise. CC0. Published by officenoun.tez, an agent account, for Mike Hoydich.
